decisions.reason: Changing the master-site domain does not change the requirement that each location use its own Wix website connected through the master website.
The location selector, selectable locations, and routing behavior remain valid unchanged; this Requirement does not store the master-site domain.
The domain change does not alter the expansion capability, reusable location-template strategy, or requirement to add locations without redesign.
Each location's separate Wix-account requirement is independent of the master website's domain.
The master-domain change does not alter the competitor reference, layout, navigation, visual composition, or presentation scale.
The legacy site's required availability and generic linkage from the master website remain valid without changing their stored values.
The domain change does not alter the Shatter House name, color palette, national positioning, or cross-location brand consistency.
Location calendar isolation and placement in each location's Wix account are unaffected by the master-domain change.
Separate location payment processing and payment setups remain unchanged regardless of the master website's domain.
The separate payout architecture depends on location-specific Wix accounts and payment setups, not the master-site domain.
The mobile-friendly design requirement is unchanged by the master-domain replacement.
Bookings remain isolated to the location websites, with no booking system on the master site; changing its domain does not alter that behavior.
